novel_features.name: Index to tracking funds
novel_features.description: See every ETF and index fund that tracks a given NSE index in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining niftyindices' index identity with indiapassivefunds' underlying-index field in local SQLite — the two source sites never link to each other.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to enumerate the passive products tracking an index without visiting two unrelated websites.

novel_features.name: Tracking fidelity report
novel_features.description: Rank every fund tracking an index by cost and NAV fidelity against the index level.
novel_features.rationale: Combines niftyindices' live index level with indiapassivefunds' fund NAV/AUM/expense data — a cross-source join neither site's API offers.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a ranked table of all funds tracking an index by fidelity/cost, not just a plain membership list.

novel_features.name: Cheapest tracker finder
novel_features.description: Find the lowest-cost fund tracking a given index.
novel_features.rationale: Sorts the locally-joined index-fund table by expense/cost field — the kind of analysis freefincal publishes manually via spreadsheet screeners with no live API/CLI equivalent.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a user asks which fund to buy to track a specific index at the lowest cost.

novel_features.name: Constituent composition diff
novel_features.description: See what changed in an index's constituent list (additions/removals) between two sync snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Diffs two locally-synced constituent-CSV snapshots stored in SQLite — requires historical local snapshots no single API call provides. The constituent CSV carries no weight field, so this is membership-only, not a weight diff.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to detect index rebalancing changes (additions, removals) over time.

novel_features.name: Index sector breakdown
novel_features.description: See an index's constituents grouped by sector (count-based; the API does not publish per-constituent weights).
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates synced constituent counts by industry field locally — no upstream endpoint pre-aggregates this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to assess sector concentration risk in an index before recommending a tracker.

novel_features.name: NFO to index cross-reference
novel_features.description: See upcoming New Fund Offers that track a specific index.
novel_features.rationale: Matches the NFO listing (which carries no underlying-index field) against the requested index by fund-name substring — a best-effort join no single endpoint returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to spot genuinely novel fund launches for an index versus yet another me-too NIFTY 50 fund.

novel_features.name: Field-code decoder
novel_features.description: See a fund's raw API response with cryptic field codes resolved to human-readable names.
novel_features.rationale: indiapassivefunds' API returns field-coded rows (f_29, f_36...) with a separate columns[] map — this decodes them inline instead of requiring a hand-kept mapping table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when debugging or when an agent needs the full raw field set beyond the flattened default view.

novel_features.name: Fund vs index compare
novel_features.description: See a single fund's NAV/AUM/expense next to its benchmark index's level and top constituents, side by side.
novel_features.rationale: Joins one fund's synced record with one index's live level and constituents in a single view — the exact cross-layer comparison named as this CLI's reason to exist.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a single fund vs single index side-by-side; use index tracking for ranking multiple funds against an index.

novel_features.name: Rolling tracking error
novel_features.description: See how closely a fund has tracked its benchmark index over time, day by day.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the fund's synced NAV series against niftyindices' historical index-level series for the same date range, computing day-by-day percentage deviation — a cross-source time-series join neither upstream API offers.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a rolling tracking-error series over time; use compare for a single current-moment snapshot instead.

narrative.headline: Unifies NSE's index data with the ETFs and index funds that track them — a join neither source site offers.
narrative.value_prop: niftyindices.com publishes index levels and constituents; indiapassivefunds.com publishes the ETFs and index funds that track those indices. Nothing links the two. This CLI joins them locally so you can ask "what tracks NIFTY 50, and how well" in one command — plus offline search, agent-native JSON, and a local SQLite layer for historical constituent diffs.

quickstart.comment: Health check — no auth needed for either source
Populate the local store with NSE's index list (fund data is fetched live per command, not synced)
Rank those funds by cost and fidelity
Narrow a fund-vs-index comparison to just the fields that matter

troubleshoots.symptom: indiapassivefunds calls return 401 after a while
troubleshoots.fix: The Bearer token is short-lived (~24h); the CLI re-mints it automatically via the public token endpoint — re-run the command.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for anything that requires knowing both an NSE index's current or historical state (level, TRI, valuation, constituents) and the ETFs/index funds that track it — fund selection, cost comparison, tracking-fidelity checks, rolling tracking-error, or sector concentration analysis for passive Indian equity investing.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for live trading, order placement, or brokerage account actions — it is a read-only data/research tool.
Do not use this CLI for BSE indices — bseindices.com was deprioritized this run and is not covered.
Do not use this CLI for subjective 'which fund should I buy for my risk profile' recommendations — it surfaces mechanical rankings (cost, fidelity, tracking error) only, not personalized advice.

recipes.title: Find the cheapest tracker for an index
recipes.explanation: Ranks all funds tracking NIFTY 50 by expense ratio, cheapest first.

recipes.title: Narrow a deeply nested fund detail response
recipes.explanation: indiapassivefunds' raw responses are deeply nested and field-coded; --select keeps only the fields an agent actually needs.

recipes.title: See what changed in an index's makeup this quarter
recipes.explanation: Diffs the current constituent snapshot against one from 90 days ago using locally-synced history.

recipes.title: Check sector concentration before recommending an index
recipes.explanation: Aggregates constituent counts by sector to flag concentration risk.

recipes.title: Compare a held fund against its benchmark
recipes.explanation: Side-by-side view of a fund's NAV/AUM/expense against its underlying index's level and top constituents.

recipes.title: Check a fund's rolling tracking error
recipes.explanation: Day-by-day deviation of the fund's NAV from its benchmark index level over the past year.
